findings.text: blocking: the arms table labels the head gate as revision 5b0a1f537ef9 (the base) and :51 quotes the base gate's own output ("2 passed in 2.14s") under the heading "Head run", while :55 cites scoped-gate-1795045375309005199.log, the base-revision log, as the head gate; the head gate that exists is scoped-gate-1795045790407984643.log at aea8a7db ("2 passed in 1.87s"), so the one artefact the done_when requires to carry the head run records none, and a reader of the landed record cannot tell which revision passed.

non-blocking: the summary asserts the gate ran "as an all_debug batch job", but the gate logs' headers carry no partition line and scoped-gate-1795045375309005199.log.scheduler is empty, so the partition rests on the manifest's prose; the done_when's "as a job on all_debug" is therefore not verifiable from the artefact.

non-blocking: the recorded baseline_suite and after_suite both ran tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, which do not import what the node touched, so the measured added_failure_count 0 is a property of two unrelated files rather than evidence about this change; the manifest records the fact under outside_scope but the arms still stand as the node's suite pair.

non-blocking: the head gate log records an uncaught FileNotFoundError through reckon/crew/station_obligations.py:591 publish, prefixed "station-obligations-failure: sample: export could not complete", which the base gate log does not emit; the run still reads 2 passed EXIT=0 and the fragment and manifest both describe it as a clean pass without it, so a swallowed failure inside the measured run is invisible in the record.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the change is a static evidence fragment; the only production code that can reach it is the evidence composer, reckon/evidence.py:1610 _fragment_body_bytes and :1657 compose_landed_record, which enumerate docs/evidence/fragments/<plan>/ and append each fragment's body to the plan's landed record.
item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit aea8a7db3b against 5b0a1f5: one new file, the 58-line evidence fragment, with a summary paragraph, a history paragraph, a quoted control, an arms table, a quoted head-run block and a logs paragraph; no source or test change.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when requires the file to pass in full at head as an all_debug job with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, its output on shared storage, and the base run with its failing ids logged beside the head run in the plan's fragment; the logs satisfy the head/control arms (head EXIT=0 at aea8a7db, control 1 failed at 57f325ecfb EXIT=1) but the fragment records the base revision as the head gate at qwnw-red-file-a-reflex-review-appears-as-working.html:44.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal line in /home/... behind the node: the goal line names "Make tests/test_a_reflex_review_appears_as_working.py pass in full on the primary branch"; the file passes 2/2 at the base revision (scoped-gate-1795045375309005199.log, EXIT=0) and again at the head (scoped-gate-1795045790407984643.log, EXIT=0), so the deliverable condition holds without a product edit.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete, one commit aea8a7db3b, tests: from a bespoke env-prefixed pytest command, test_logs naming both scoped gates and the control log, and baseline_suite/after_suite at 58 passed EXIT=0 each with failure_count 0.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths were reckon, tests, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround and its named fragment, and docs/figures/...; git diff 5b0a1f537ef9..aea8a7db3b lists only the named fragment file, inside that set.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion and no product code, so nothing of its own can regress; the guard is the pre-existing tests/test_a_reflex_review_appears_as_working.py:98, which fires on the defect it names in the control log logs/control-57f325ecfb.log (1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1), but the node added no guard for its own record and the fragment's mislabelled revision (:44) is exactly what no assertion caught.
justifications.evidence: the head gate log scoped-gate-1795045790407984643.log reads "2 passed in 1.87s" EXIT=0 at aea8a7db with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, but the delivered fragment docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-a-reflex-review-appears-as-working.html:44 names 5b0a1f5 as the head gate revision and :51 quotes the base gate's timing, so the artefact carries no head run.
justifications.fit: the fragment is a document-wrapped page whose element ids all begin with the node id (:19-55) and which reckon/evidence.py:1610 _fragment_body_bytes strips to its body, so it composes the same way a bare-section sibling does.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node goal is that tests/test_a_reflex_review_appears_as_working.py passes in full on the primary branch; the file already read 2 passed EXIT=0 at the base revision 5b0a1f537ef9 and the node made no product change, which is the done_when's already-passing branch.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no definition of any kind; it reuses the plan's existing fragment directory and the existing scoped gate, and the capability of composing evidence fragments is owned by reckon/evidence.py:1657 compose_landed_record, which the search over reckon/ found as the owner of this path and which reads everything under the plan's fragment directory.
justifications.scope_discipline: the single commit aea8a7db3b touches exactly one path, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-a-reflex-review-appears-as-working.html:1-58, which is inside the node's declared fragment write path and nothing else.
